headline: Eurobarometer finds 42% of surveyed EU SMEs and mid-caps currently use AI or algorithmic management
summary: The European Commission published Flash Eurobarometer 578 on October 14, 2026, reporting on telephone interviews with 12,826 heads of privately owned small and medium-sized enterprises and mid-caps with 1–749 employees across all 27 EU member states. In the survey’s combined AI-or-algorithmic-management categories, 42% reported current use (12% extensive and 30% limited or experimental), 21% planned use, 35% had no plan, and 2% did not know. The infographic also reports that 75% expected these tools to improve job quality. These are company-reported survey responses: the measure combines AI with algorithmic management, and does not establish independently verified deployment, productivity, or workforce effects.
